# 1 Samuel Chapter 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 158v–159r | **Source Image:** 1SA_015_page_001.jpg, 1SA_015_page_002.jpg, 1SA_015_page_003.jpg

---

**15:1** And-said Samuel to Saul, "Me YHWH sent to-anoint-you [as]-king over His-people, over-Israel. And-now hear the-voice of-[the]-words of-YHWH.

**15:2** Thus says YHWH of-hosts: 'I-have-attended-to [paqadti] what Amalek did to-Israel, [how] he-set against-him in-the-way when-he-came-up from-Egypt.

**15:3** Now go and-strike Amalek and-devote-to-destruction [ha-charamtem] all that [is]-to-him, and-do-not spare him: and-put-to-death from-man unto-woman, from-child unto-suckling, from-ox unto-sheep, from-camel unto-donkey.'"

**15:4** And-Saul summoned the-people and-numbered-them in-Telaim: two-hundred thousand foot-soldiers, and-ten thousand men of-Judah.

**15:5** And-came Saul unto [the]-city of-Amalek and-lay-in-wait [va-yarev] in-the-wadi.

**15:6** And-said Saul to-the-Kenite, "Go, depart, go-down from-among the-Amalekites, lest I-destroy you with-them, for you showed lovingkindness [hesed] with-all [the]-sons of-Israel when-they-came-up from-Egypt." And-departed the-Kenite from-among Amalek.

**15:7** And-struck Saul Amalek from-Havilah [as]-you-come to-Shur, which [is] upon [the]-face of-Egypt.

**15:8** And-he-captured Agag king of-Amalek alive, and-all the-people he-devoted-to-destruction [hecherim] with-[the]-edge of-the-sword.

**15:9** And-spared Saul and-the-people Agag and-the-best of-the-sheep and-the-cattle and-the-fatlings and-the-lambs and-all the-good, and-they-were-not-willing to-devote-them-to-destruction. But-all the-property [melakhah] [that was]-despised and-refuse [namses], that they-devoted-to-destruction.

**15:10** And-was [the]-word of-YHWH to-Samuel, saying,

**15:11** "I-regret [nichamti] that I-made Saul king, for he-has-turned-back from-following-Me and-My-words he-has-not established." And-it-burned to-Samuel, and-he-cried to-YHWH all the-night.

**15:12** And-rose-early Samuel to-meet Saul in-the-morning. And-it-was-told to-Samuel, saying, "Saul came to-Carmel, and-behold, he-is-setting-up for-himself a-monument [yad], and-he-turned and-passed-on and-went-down to-Gilgal."

**15:13** And-came Samuel to-Saul, and-said Saul to-him, "Blessed [are]-you to-YHWH. I-have-established the-word of-YHWH."

**15:14** And-said Samuel, "And-what [is] this sound of-the-flock in-my-ears and-[the]-sound of-the-cattle which I hear?"

**15:15** And-said Saul, "From-the-Amalekites they-brought-them, for the-people spared the-best of-the-flock and-the-cattle, in-order to-sacrifice to-YHWH your-God. And-the-rest we-devoted-to-destruction."

**15:16** And-said Samuel to-Saul, "Cease, and-I-will-tell you what YHWH spoke to-me the-night." And-he-said to-him, "Speak."

**15:17** And-said Samuel, "Is-it-not [that] though-small you [were] in-your-own-eyes, [you are the]-head of-the-tribes of-Israel? And-YHWH anointed you [as]-king over-Israel.

**15:18** And-YHWH sent you on-a-way and-said, 'Go and-devote-to-destruction the-sinners, Amalek, and-fight against-them until they-are-consumed.'

**15:19** And-why did-you-not obey the-voice of-YHWH? And-you-rushed to the-spoil and-did the-evil in-[the]-eyes of-YHWH."

**15:20** And-said Saul to-Samuel, "Indeed I-obeyed the-voice of-YHWH and-I-went on-the-way which YHWH sent-me, and-I-brought Agag king of-Amalek, and-Amalek I-devoted-to-destruction.

**15:21** And-the-people took from-the-spoil sheep and-cattle, the-best of-the-devoted-things, to-sacrifice to-YHWH your-God in-Gilgal."

**15:22** And-said Samuel, "Has-YHWH [as much]-delight in-burnt-offerings and-sacrifices as-in-obeying the-voice of-YHWH? Behold, to-obey [is]-better than-sacrifice; to-give-heed [is better] than-[the]-fat of-rams.

**15:23** For [the]-sin of-divination [qesem] [is]-rebellion, and-[the]-iniquity of-teraphim [is]-stubbornness. Because you-have-rejected the-word of-YHWH, He-has-rejected you from-[being]-king."

**15:24** And-said Saul to-Samuel, "I-have-sinned, for I-transgressed the-command of-YHWH and-your-words, for I-feared the-people and-I-obeyed their-voice.

**15:25** And-now bear, please, my-sin, and-return with-me, and-I-will-worship YHWH."

**15:26** And-said Samuel to-Saul, "I-will-not return with-you, for you-have-rejected the-word of-YHWH, and-YHWH has-rejected you from-being king over-Israel."

**15:27** And-turned Samuel to-go, and-he-seized the-edge of-his-robe, and-it-tore.

**15:28** And-said Samuel to-him, "YHWH has-torn the-kingdom of-Israel from-upon-you today and-has-given it to-your-neighbor who-[is]-better than-you.

**15:29** And-also the-Glory [Netsach] of-Israel will-not lie and-will-not relent [yinnachem], for not a-man He [is] to-relent."

**15:30** And-he-said, "I-have-sinned. Now honor-me, please, before [the]-elders of-my-people and-before Israel, and-return with-me, and-I-will-worship YHWH your-God."

**15:31** And-returned Samuel after Saul, and-worshiped Saul to-YHWH.

**15:32** And-said Samuel, "Bring-near to-me Agag king of-Amalek." And-went to-him Agag in-bonds [ma'adannot]. And-said Agag, "Surely the-bitterness of-death has-turned-aside."

**15:33** And-said Samuel, "As your-sword bereaved women, so-shall-be-bereaved among-women your-mother." And-Samuel hewed [va-yeshasseph] Agag before YHWH in-Gilgal.

**15:34** And-went Samuel to-Ramah, and-Saul went-up to-his-house, [to]-Gibeah of-Saul.

**15:35** And-Samuel did-not add to-see Saul until the-day of-his-death, for Samuel mourned for-Saul. And-YHWH regretted [nicham] that He-had-made Saul king over-Israel.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **15:3 — cherem** (חֵרֶם): The devoted ban — total destruction consecrated to YHWH. This is the most theologically difficult institution in the OT. EMET renders it literally as "devote to destruction."

2. **15:11 — nichamti** (נִחַמְתִּי): "I regret/relent" — the same root (*n-ch-m*) used in v.29 where Samuel says God "will not relent." This creates a deliberate theological tension within the chapter itself.

3. **15:23 — Divination/teraphim parallel**: Samuel equates Saul's disobedience with the very practices forbidden in Deuteronomy 18. The chiastic structure (sin of divination = rebellion / iniquity of teraphim = stubbornness) is preserved.

4. **15:29 — Netsach Yisrael** (נֵצַח יִשְׂרָאֵל): "Glory/Endurance of Israel" — a divine epithet unique to this verse. Can mean "Eternity" or "Victory" or "Glory."

5. **15:32 — ma'adannot** (מַעֲדַנֹּת): Difficult word, variously rendered "cheerfully," "haltingly," "in bonds." EMET follows "in bonds" based on the root *ʿ-d-n*.

6. **15:33 — va-yeshasseph** (וַיְשַׁסֵּף): "hewed/hacked" — a rare verb appearing only here in the Bible. The brutality is not softened.

— EMET
